The season began on 18 February and ended on 13 November 2022.{{cite web |url=https://studiofutbol.com.ec/2022/01/11/las-finales-de-la-ligapro-betcris-2022-se-jugaran-el-6-y-13-de-noviembre/ |title=Noticia Banco Guayaquil: Finales de LigaPro 2022 serán el 6 y 13 de noviembre |trans-title=Banco Guayaquil News: 2022 LigaPro Finals will be on 6 and 13 November |publisher=Studio Fútbol |language=es |date=11 January 2022 |access-date=13 January 2022}} [[S.D. Aucas|Aucas]] won their first Serie A title in this season, defeating [[Barcelona S.C.|Barcelona]] in the finals by a 1–0 aggregate score.{{cite web |url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/campeonato-ecuatoriano/en-vivo-aucas-vs-barcelona-sc-campeon-de-la-liga-pro-2022-nota/?modulo=destacadas-uno&plantilla=home |title=¡Aucas, campeón de la Liga Pro! el equipo del sur de Quito venció en la final a Barcelona SC y levantó su primer título en la historia del campeonato ecuatoriano |trans-title=Aucas, Liga Pro champions! The team from southern Quito beat Barcelona SC in the final and lifted their first title in Ecuadorian championship history |publisher=El Universo |language=es |date=13 November 2022 |access-date=13 November 2022}} [[C.S.D. Independiente del Valle|Independiente del Valle]] were the defending champions. ==Teams== 16 teams competed in the season. [[Manta F.C.|Manta]] and [[C.D. Olmedo|Olmedo]] were relegated after finishing in the bottom two places of the aggregate table of the previous season, being replaced by the [[Ecuadorian Serie B|2021 Serie B]] champions [[Cumbayá F.C.|Cumbayá]] and runners-up [[Gualaceo S.C.|Gualaceo]]. Cumbayá clinched promotion to the top flight with three matches in hand after a 2–1 win over Independiente Juniors on 23 September 2021,{{cite web |url=https://www.eluniverso.com/deportes/futbol/cuando-faltan-tres-fechas-para-el-final-de-la-serie-b-cumbaya-fc-alcanza-el-ascenso-a-la-serie-a-nota/ |title=Cuando faltan tres fechas para el final de la serie B, Cumbayá FC alcanza el ascenso a la serie A|trans-title=With three matchdays to go until the end of Serie B, Cumbayá FC reach promotion to Serie A|publisher=El Universo |access-date=2 December 2021 |language=es |date=24 September 2021}} whilst Gualaceo ensured promotion on 13 October 2021, with a 2–1 victory against Atlético Santo Domingo and a draw for El Nacional against Independiente Juniors.{{cite web |url=https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/futbol/gualaceo-ascendio-primera-vez-serie.html |title=Gualaceo ascendió por primera vez a la Serie A |trans-title=Gualaceo were promoted to Serie A for the first time ever|publisher=El Comercio |access-date=2 December 2021 |language=es |date=13 October 2021}} Both promoted teams took part in Serie A for the first time ever. ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2022 Serie A clubs. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-1.244866 |long=-78.623184 |label=
